title: Audit eight binary senders and their unique correction pattern
body:
**Independent binary audit:** every subset of the eight sender replacements in [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) preserves its surviving public operator and has a causal same-chart schedule. After all eight helper restrictions, the eight stated sender corrections are uniquely necessary in the include-or-omit family. Their errors cannot cancel. **No new kappa** or full ordinary-service admission is claimed. This audits the binary service that limits the source's conditional bound.

Read the [simultaneous contraction proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/373606b10faab4b9732340ad7c886ce828badf20/research/bit-eight-sender-audit/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/373606b10faab4b9732340ad7c886ce828badf20/research/bit-eight-sender-audit/RESULT.json), [independent checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/373606b10faab4b9732340ad7c886ce828badf20/research/bit-eight-sender-audit/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/373606b10faab4b9732340ad7c886ce828badf20/research/bit-eight-sender-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/373606b10faab4b9732340ad7c886ce828badf20/research/bit-eight-sender-audit/CREDITS.md). The scientific source is pinned at `0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Independent word extraction | All 34,137 instructions; chart tags and owned lifetimes checked |
| Restriction subsets | All 256; 109,830,912 scalar matrix entries covered in each orientation |
| Correction patterns | All 256 after the full restriction; only all eight corrections pass |
| Missing-correction errors | Eight rank-one errors on eight distinct main outputs |
| Final native | Rank 651 public map; 651 public fields; 2,855 paid packets |

The proof projects the original reverse output columns away from the surrendered helpers. A deleted packet has zero projected column; each aliased packet has the same projected column as its retained donor. Adding the deleted sender row to that donor preserves every reverse equation. Acyclicity makes their solution unique. The checker verifies this invariant at every retained label for every subset, with separate forward and reverse propagation.

Each edit removes paid ranks 1 and 3 and surrenders an independent rank-4 helper. With the same 36-call caller, the complete signed margin gains `288*(1+3^(1-C)-4^(1-C))`, positive for `0<C<1`. The target debit is necessary: the resulting map has only 651 independent public directions. The caller multiplicity and full ordinary integration are inherited, not replayed here. All eight donors occur earlier than their retired partners in the old forward word, so the equivalent old reverse alias misses its deadline. The new causal delivery is part of the construction; fixed-bank exclusions do not apply unchanged.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-eight-sender-audit
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_BIT_EIGHT_SENDER_AUDIT 256 subsets 109830912 entries each way 8 omission controls
```

All ten retained files are authenticated. Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Every omitted correction has a recorded one-input witness. The independent graph agrees with the source implementation and binds to its published emitted-word digest. This is a binding check, not a physical-word replay. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44457787906/job/135336938004) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the eight edits in the [binary source proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/BIT-PROOF.md), [constructor](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/bit_native.py) and [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/BIT-RESULT.json). Jerry Chen (@CubeJerry) supplied [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001)'s selected application and retained [native word](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/paired-query-only-bit/retained/inputs/BIT-NATIVE-WORD.json.gz). DreamingOfClouds supplied the paired caller lineage; zxv and retained authors supplied the earlier native source. All original notices remain intact.

AlephNaN (@alephnan) supplied the fixed-delivery restriction theorem in [PR #7733](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7733). Its hypothesis differs from the changed senders here. This audit uses a new set-based extraction and graph checker; the submitted code runs only for final graph equality and emitted-word binding. It is source-aware implementation independence, not blind or independent human acceptance.

No rational projector, all-width physical native, complete caller, owned-erasure implementation, tape layout, ordinary stock, interval gate or compiler replay ran. No global sender optimum, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
